Outer space has long been a priority for China. In the 1950s, the Communist Party coined the term “two bombs, one satellite” as a signpost for its scientific aspirations: develop an atomic bomb, a missile, and a satellite. 

Today, China is aiming much higher, with the help of the private sector.
